'''Berand''' was an individual who served the [[Justicars' Brigade]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="Encounter" /> around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Wiped Clean|Coruscant}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Berand was first mentioned in the dynamic encounter mission "Wiped Clean" in the Justicars' Database<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
